items.title: A Complete Guide to GST Registration in India
items.excerpt: When your business needs GST registration, what documents are required, and how to avoid common filing delays.
items.author: Reasonable Compliance
items.seoTitle: GST Registration Guide India | Reasonable Compliance
items.seoDescription: Step-by-step guide to GST registration in India — eligibility, documents, process and tips for startups and SMEs.
items.body:
GST registration is essential once your business crosses the prescribed turnover threshold, or when you need to sell on e-commerce platforms, claim input tax credit, or work with registered buyers.

Who typically needs GST registration?
- Businesses crossing the GST threshold for goods or services
- Inter-state suppliers
- E-commerce sellers and operators in many cases
- Businesses wanting to claim input tax credit

Documents commonly required
- PAN of the business / proprietor / directors
- Aadhaar and identity proofs
- Proof of business address
- Bank account details
- Photographs and authorization documents where applicable

items.title: How to Choose the Right Trademark for Your Brand
items.excerpt: A strong trademark protects your brand identity. Here is how to pick a name worth registering.
items.author: Reasonable Compliance
items.seoTitle: How to Choose the Right Trademark | Reasonable Compliance
items.seoDescription: Tips to choose a distinctive trademark, avoid refusals, and protect your brand with trademark registration in India.
items.body:
Your trademark is often the first signal customers recognise. Choosing well reduces refusal risk and strengthens brand protection.

Prefer distinctive marks
Invented words, unique logos and distinctive combinations are usually stronger than generic or purely descriptive names.

Check availability early
Before printing packaging or launching ads, run a trademark search for similar marks in relevant classes.

Think long term
Pick a mark you can grow with — across products, regions and digital channels.

Register and monitor
Filing is only the start. Timely responses to examination reports and renewal tracking keep your rights intact.

Reasonable Compliance supports trademark search guidance, filing and related IP compliance so your brand is protected while you focus on growth.

items.title: Why Every Company Needs Timely ROC Compliance
items.excerpt: Missed ROC filings can lead to penalties and director disqualification. Here is what to stay on top of.
items.author: Reasonable Compliance
items.seoTitle: ROC Compliance Importance for Companies | Reasonable Compliance
items.seoDescription: Why annual and event-based ROC filings matter for private limited companies and how secretarial compliance protects your business.
items.body:
Private limited companies and many other entities must comply with the Companies Act through ROC filings, board documentation and secretarial records.

Key areas to track
- Annual filings and financial statement submissions
- Event-based filings (director changes, capital changes, registered office updates)
- Board meeting and AGM documentation
- Director KYC and related compliance

Risks of delay
Late filings can attract penalties, create roadblocks for funding or banking, and in serious cases affect director status.

A practical approach
Maintain a compliance calendar, keep statutory registers updated, and work with a dedicated compliance partner who monitors deadlines.

items.title: Company Registration Checklist for New Founders
items.excerpt: From choosing Private Limited vs LLP to post-incorporation registrations — a practical checklist for first-time founders.
items.author: Reasonable Compliance
items.seoTitle: Company Registration Checklist India | Reasonable Compliance
items.seoDescription: Founder checklist for company registration in India — structure choice, documents, incorporation steps and first compliance actions.
items.body:
Starting a company is exciting — and easier when you follow a clear checklist.

1. Choose the right structure
Private Limited, LLP, OPC or Partnership each suit different ownership, funding and compliance needs.

2. Arrange identity and address proofs
Directors / partners typically need PAN, Aadhaar and address documents. The company needs a registered office proof.

3. Name approval and incorporation filing
Reserve a suitable name and complete SPICe+ / LLP incorporation filings with the required declarations.

4. Post-incorporation essentials
Open a bank account, evaluate GST / MSME / professional tax needs, and set up your first board / compliance calendar.

5. Stay compliant from day one
Early habits — minutes, registers and timely filings — prevent expensive cleanup later.

Reasonable Compliance helps founders complete incorporation and the first wave of registrations with clear timelines and transparent pricing.
